scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R src/store/migrations dist/store/migrations && pnpm --filter @aw/web run build
scripts.bundle:proxy: pnpm --filter @aw/collector exec esbuild ../dist/mcp/proxy/main.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __awCjsRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __awCjsRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=../dist/agent-host/aw-proxy.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:web
